strings.zh: 哦！{NEWLINE}你是？{SCROLL}啊！第一次来地下么？{NEWLINE}欢迎来到新奥地下通道！{SCROLL}请看下雷达,{NEWLINE}这就是地下通道的全部了！{CLEAR}怎么样？很大吧！{SCROLL}第一次来地下的话,{NEWLINE}首先建立一个秘密基地比较好哦~{SCROLL}用钻头喀喀喀地在墙壁上打个洞,{CLEAR}肯定很快就可以做好了~{SCROLL}然后就是看着雷达挖掘化石,{CLEAR}做陷阱⋯⋯之类。{NEWLINE}对了,比起说明,{NEWLINE}还是自己亲身实践一下比较呢！{SCROLL}可以试着叫上朋友一起来玩！{SCROLL}那再见啦！{NEWLINE}我们一定还会再见的！
strings.en: Oh! Who are you?{SCROLL}Ah! First time in the Underground?{NEWLINE}Welcome to the Sinnoh Underground!{SCROLL}Take a look at the radar. That’s the{NEWLINE}whole Underground! Pretty big, huh?{SCROLL}If this is your first time down here, you{NEWLINE}should start by making a Secret Base!{SCROLL}Just drill a hole in a wall, clack-clack!{NEWLINE}You’ll have one in no time!{SCROLL}After that, you can dig for fossils with{NEWLINE}the radar, set traps… that sort of{CLEAR}thing. Oh, and rather than listen to me{CLEAR}explain, it’s better to try it yourself!{SCROLL}Try inviting your friends to play, too!{SCROLL}See you! We’ll meet again for sure!
